2609.24274.title: vla.simd: Efficient CPU Inference for Language-Conditioned Manipulation
2609.24274.paper_summary: Deploying language-conditioned manipulation without a dedicated GPU requires efficient inference and action chunks that cover the delay between policy queries. We present vla.simd, a CPU inference engine that combines shared SIMD micro-kernels, reusable computation, and target-specific optimization. We relate query latency and execution horizon to action availability under lagged and time-aligned execution, distinguishing action supply from feedback frequency. Across six policies and four CPUs, vla.simd achieves approximately $1.4\times$ median speedup over compiled PyTorch references while preserving fp32 numerical fidelity. We also introduce IMPACT, an ACT-based policy with cached text representations and language-modulated visual features. IMPACT is the only language-conditioned policy in our evaluated set that supplies at least 30 actions/s on the Raspberry Pi 5: after a 90 s thermal soak, it supplies 33.5 actions/s in fp32 and 81.2 with int8. Separate GPU evaluations yield $76.4\%$ mean success across four LIBERO suites without robot pretraining; instruction-shuffling tests demonstrate selection among familiar goals. Trials with IMPACT on an SO-101 arm and SmolVLA on a UR10e with a Robotiq gripper demonstrate CPU deployment on two robot embodiments.
2609.24274.paper_summary_zh: 部署無需專用 GPU 的語言條件操控需要高效的推理和行動片段，以涵蓋策略查詢之間的延遲。<lb/>我們提出了 vla.simd，一個結合了共享 SIMD 微內核、可重用計算和針對特定目標優化的 CPU 推理引擎。<lb/>我們將查詢延遲和執行視野與延遲和時間對齊執行下的行動可用性相關聯，區分行動供應和反饋頻率。<lb/>在六個策略和四個 CPU 上，vla.simd 在保持 fp32 數值保真度的同時，實現了大約 $1.4\times$ 的中位數加速，相較於編譯的 PyTorch 參考。<lb/>我們還介紹了 IMPACT，一種基於 ACT 的政策，具有緩存的文本表示和語言調制的視覺特徵。<lb/>IMPACT 是我們評估集中的唯一語言條件政策，在 Raspberry Pi 5 上提供至少 30 個行動/秒：在 90 秒的熱浸泡後，它在 fp32 中提供 33.5 個行動/秒，並在 int8 中提供 81.2 個行動/秒。<lb/>單獨的 GPU 評估在四個 LIBERO 套件中實現了 $76.4\%$ 的平均成功率，無需機器人預訓練；指令洗牌測試展示了在熟悉目標之間的選擇。<lb/>在 SO-101 臂上的 IMPACT 和在 UR10e 上配備 Robotiq 夾爪的 SmolVLA 的試驗展示了在兩個機器人實體上的 CPU 部署。
